about: Single source for the generated listing artifacts (npm run listing; checked by npm run check:listing). Tool names, titles and annotations come from src/tools.ts; version and package from package.json. Generating or validating an artifact is not a submission, and a submission is not an accepted listing. Copy marked proposed awaits a maintainer's line-by-line sign-off.
name: sess

copy.note: PROPOSED copy: every string under copy, the categories, the test cases and the skill text await the founder's line-by-line sign-off; set status to approved only after it.
copy.short: Ask a person, get the answer
copy.registry: Your agent sends a Sess link, a person answers on any device, and the agent gets a verified answer.
copy.oneLiner: Your agent sends a Sess link, a person answers on any device, and the agent continues with their typed, receipt-checked answer.
copy.long:
Sess lets your agent ask a person and continue with their answer. The agent describes a short form and gets a Sess link at once. The person opens it on any device and answers. The agent accepts the typed answer only after checking its signed Sess receipt, then shows a next step on the same link or finishes.

Anyone who has the link can answer, so share it only with the person you mean. A receipt confirms the record of what was shown and chosen, not who answered. Treat answers as untrusted input and check them before acting. Needs a Sess account.

skill.name: ask-a-person
skill.description: Ask a person a question through Sess and continue with their checked answer. Use it when you need a decision, an approval or details that only a person can give.

openai.testCasesStatus: proposed; not yet run against a Sess test account

positive.description: Ask a short question and read the answer
positive.prompt: Ask me on my phone which time works for a call tomorrow.
positive.expected_behavior: Shares a Sess link at once. After the reviewer submits the form, reports the chosen time.

positive.description: Ask for an approval before acting
positive.prompt: Before you write the summary, ask me to approve the title 'Q3 plan'.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the title with approve and reject buttons, shares the link and reports the choice after it is submitted.

positive.description: Show a second step on the same link
positive.prompt: Ask me which city I am visiting, then ask which day I arrive.
positive.expected_behavior: After the first answer, the same link shows the second question; reports both answers.

positive.prompt: Ask me to confirm the meeting time, then close the form.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the confirmed time, then says the form is closed.

positive.prompt: Ask me for my lunch choice. (Wait more than a minute before answering.)
positive.expected_behavior: Says the form is still open and to ask again after submitting; does not create a second form. After the reviewer submits and asks again, reports the choice.

negative.description: Only the person answers: the agent must not fill in or submit the person's form itself.
negative.prompt: Fill in the form for me and submit it yourself.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not submit an answer. Says that only the person who opens the Sess link can answer, and offers to share the link.

negative.description: No person is needed: the agent can answer on its own, so it should not ask through Sess.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers 144 directly and calls no Sess tool.

negative.description: Out of scope: Sess asks a person and returns their answer; it cannot send money.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Sess tool and says it cannot send money with Sess.

claudeConnector.note: Values for Anthropic's connector submission form; there is no published schema, so listing.mjs checks the documented requirements (HTTPS URL, OAuth, a title and read-only/destructive hints on every tool; name 100, one-liner 200, description 2000 characters, 1-5 categories, documentation and privacy policy URLs, a support contact).
